privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Prometey VPN collects, uses, stores, and protects account, payment, support, and service data.

sections.title: What we collect
body: We collect the account information needed to create and protect your profile, such as email address, authentication data, Telegram link status, and service settings.

When payment integrations are enabled, payment processing may be handled by a third-party provider. Prometey VPN should only store the minimum billing status data required to activate or renew access.

sections.title: How we use data
body: We use data to authenticate users, issue VPN configuration files, provide support, prevent abuse, process subscriptions, and keep the service stable.
Operational logs may be used to diagnose backend errors, security events, and service availability problems.

sections.title: Retention and security
body: We keep account and service data only while it is needed for the purposes described here or required by law.
Access to administrative systems should be restricted, audited, and protected with secure credentials.

sections.title: Contact
body: For privacy questions, data access requests, or account deletion requests, contact support through the official Telegram channel listed on this site.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The rules for using Prometey VPN, managing your account, and accessing VPN configuration files.

sections.title: Service access
body: Prometey VPN provides access to VPN configuration files and related account tools after registration and, where applicable, subscription activation.
You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for any activity performed through your account.

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: You must use the service lawfully and must not use Prometey VPN to attack systems, distribute malware, send spam, commit fraud, or violate the rights of others.
We may restrict or suspend access when usage creates security, legal, or operational risk.

sections.title: Subscriptions
body: Subscription pricing, duration, and renewal details are shown before purchase or communicated through the official support channel.
Until the payment backend is finalized, checkout may be handled manually through Telegram support.

sections.title: Changes
body: We may update these terms as the product, backend contracts, or legal requirements change. Continued use of the service means you accept the updated terms.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.description: When refunds may be available and how to request support for payment or access problems.

sections.title: Refund requests
body: If you paid for access and cannot use the service because of a verified service-side issue, contact support with your account email and payment details.
Refund eligibility depends on the payment method, the subscription period, and whether VPN access was already issued and used.

sections.title: Non-refundable cases
body: Refunds may be refused for abuse, violation of the acceptable use policy, chargeback fraud, or requests made after a substantial part of the subscription period has passed.
Temporary third-party network blocks, local device issues, or unsupported client apps may require troubleshooting before a refund decision.

sections.title: How to request
body: Send your request through the official Telegram support channel. Include your account email, payment date, plan, and a short description of the problem.

aup.title: Acceptable Use Policy
aup.description: The usage rules that keep Prometey VPN safe, reliable, and available for legitimate customers.

sections.title: Prohibited activity
body: Do not use Prometey VPN for spam, phishing, malware, credential theft, denial-of-service attacks, harassment, illegal marketplaces, or unauthorized access to networks and accounts.
Do not resell, share, or automate access in a way that overloads the service or bypasses subscription limits.

sections.title: Network protection
body: We may apply technical limits, rotate configuration files, or suspend access to protect infrastructure, customers, and partners.
Security incidents may be investigated using account metadata, support records, and service-side diagnostics.

sections.title: Enforcement
body: Violations can lead to warnings, configuration regeneration, suspension, termination, or refusal of future service.

report.title: Report a Problem
report.description: How to contact support about connection issues, billing questions, account access, or abuse reports.

sections.title: Support requests
body: For connection issues, include your device, VPN client app, protocol, approximate time of failure, and any error message shown by the client.
For billing or account issues, include your account email and the plan or payment details available to you.

sections.title: Abuse reports
body: If you believe Prometey VPN infrastructure is being abused, contact support with timestamps, IP addresses or domains involved, logs if available, and a clear description of the incident.

sections.title: Where to write
body: Use the official Telegram support link from this site. It is currently the primary contact channel for MVP support and billing.
